# Grainger

> Grainger's internal systems and portals for employee access, inventory management, and enterprise authentication.

Grainger operates multiple integrated platforms for workforce management and supply chain operations. The company leverages SAP NetWeaver for enterprise resource planning and OKTA for secure identity management across its employee portal and inventory systems.

## Key Topics

- authentication
- login
- inventory management
- SAP NetWeaver
- OKTA integration
- employee portal
- user access
- account security
- password reset
- SAP AG

## Employee Portal & Authentication

- [SAP NetWeaver Portal](https://portal.sap.grainger.com/): Grainger employee portal with SAP NetWeaver and OKTA authentication for secure access to enterprise systems

## Inventory Management

- [Inventory Management System Login](https://inventory.grainger.com/): Grainger inventory management system login and authentication portal for supply chain operations
